newsitem.title: USA: United Cos shrs drop after EPS views cut.
newsitem.headline: United Cos shrs drop after EPS views cut.

text.p: Shares in United Cos Financial Corp fell more than 11 percent on Tuesday in Nasdaq trade after analysts pared their earnings estimates for the home-equity lender.
The stock tumbled at the market open, losing 5-1/8 points to 32, then partially recovered toward noon, trading at 33-1/8, a four point loss.

A company spokesman said some brokerage houses -- including Oppenheimer & Co -- cut their earnings estimates after analysts were disappointed by the expected size of the company's quarterly, asset-backed debt securitization.
The spokesman said the company expects to securitize $500 million in asset-backed debt. He said some analysts apparently expected a higher figure.
Earlier today, Oppenheimer lowered its 1996 earnings estimate to $2.62 per share from $2.75, and the buy recommendation was unchanged.
A trader said William Blair & Co also lowered its earnings outlook, though the analyst declined to comment.
In the second quarter, the company securitized $625 million in debt including a one-time bulk purchase of $150 million in debt, the spokesman said.
